item.title: OpenAI PR tells journalist to ‘move on’ while asking Sam Altman about a ChatGPT user’s suicide
item.description: An OpenAI publicist tried to change the topic of CEO Sam Altman’s interview with Vanity Fair ’s Mark Guiducci after the editor brought up a ChatGPT user’s suicide. When Guiducci confronted Altman about the incident, the publicist warned Guiducci about running out of time, saying she’d like to “move on” to another topic.

item.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
item.description: OpenAI said the new visual ads will show up after your image generation results appear in the U.S. only for now.
